title: Finding elements in a list

lines.explanation: Defining a function 'which_item' and passing the arguments 'tlist' as list type and 'value' as integer (for example).
For loop checks for items in the list iteratively.
It checks if the current item matches the value.
If it does, then it returns the index of that item. Note that 'i' is the index of that value starting from '0'.
If the item is not found, it will return -1.
Instantiating the function by passing the 'list' and the 'value' to be found in the list as arguments
